content.title: Thrombolytic regimens, doses, and contraindications
content.summary: Table of thrombolytic agents (rtPA, streptokinase, urokinase) with typical dosing regimens, accelerated regimens, and contraindications.

agents.accelerated_regimen_note: This is the accelerated regimen for rtPA in pulmonary embolism; it is not officially approved, but it is sometimes used in extreme haemodynamic instability such as cardiac arrest.

contraindications.notes: No agent-specific contraindication bullets visible adjacent to rtPA on this page image; see streptokinase and urokinase entries for listed contraindications.

agents.standard_dose: 250 000 IU as a loading dose over 30 min, followed by 100 000 IU/h over 12–24 h

absolute: History of haemorrhagic stroke or stroke of unknown origin
Major trauma, surgery, or head injury in previous 3 weeks
relative: Transient ischaemic attack in previous 6 months

agents.standard_dose: 4400 IU/kg as a loading dose over 10 min, followed by 4400 IU/kg/h over 12–24 h

footnotes: a: This is the accelerated regimen for rtPA in pulmonary embolism; it is not officially approved, but it is sometimes used in extreme haemodynamic instability such as cardiac arrest.
